name: cockpit
description: A quiet band above the prompt: model, effort, context %, cost, current task and live subagents

warnAt.title: Context amber from
warnAt.description: Where the context bar turns amber (time to /compact): a share of the window like 30%, or a token count like 60k that stays put across models with different windows.

dangerAt.title: Context red from
dangerAt.description: Where the context bar turns red: a share of the window like 50%, or a token count like 100k or 1.2m.
